full_prompt_en: A square anime style painting frames a young pilot in an intense close three quarter view, his face turned down toward the right. Dark blue black hair falls in pointed locks across his forehead, with a few strands catching hot orange light near the crown. One gray violet eye looks sharply forward beneath the shadow of the fringe. His brow is taut, the mouth set in a small straight line, and dark red scratches or stains cross the cheek and jaw. A white collared shirt and dark necktie show at the lower left. Behind and around his right shoulder sits a large violet armored shape with a bright green inset panel, its curved mechanical plates pressed close to the figure. The background is mostly midnight blue and charcoal at the upper left, becoming fiery orange and red along the right edge. Sharp highlights cut across the nose, cheek, eye, and hair, while the far side of the face falls into purple blue shadow. Thick painterly marks and distressed grain roughen the contours, which remain boldly graphic. The crop is very tight, excluding any visible setting beyond the color and armor, and the face dominates the left half. A faint cool glow separates the figure from the dark upper background. The overall image feels tense and urgent, held by the clash between blue violet mass and molten orange light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动画风绘画以紧密四分之三视角框住一名神情强烈的年轻驾驶员，他的脸向右下转去。蓝黑头发以尖锐发束落过额头，发顶几缕接住炽热橙光。一只灰紫眼睛从刘海阴影下锐利望向前方。眉头绷紧，嘴抿成小小直线，深红擦痕或污渍横过面颊和下颌。左下露出白色翻领衬衫和深领带。右肩后方贴着大型紫罗兰装甲形体，亮绿色嵌板置于弯曲机械板之间。背景左上大多为午夜蓝与炭黑，右边缘变成炽烈橙红。锐利高光切过鼻子、面颊、眼睛和头发，脸的远侧陷入紫蓝阴影。厚绘画笔痕与磨损颗粒粗化轮廓，但图形仍大胆清楚。裁切极紧，颜色和装甲之外没有可见场景，面孔主导左半。淡淡冷光把人物从深暗上部背景分开。整体紧张而急迫，由蓝紫体量与熔火般橙光冲撞维持。
style_prompt_en: Anime style painting uses sharply cut focal planes and mechanical curves inside a tightly cropped, high contrast composition. Midnight blue, violet, charcoal, and electric green oppose concentrated orange red light. Bold angular contours establish the central form, while rough brush drag, small scratches, and printlike grain interrupt clean cel shaded areas. One narrow bright focal plane receives hard warm illumination; neighboring surfaces recede quickly into cool purple shadow. Large curved plates and slanting filament-like marks lock together in compressed space without losing silhouette clarity. A few precise light edges and saturated accents guide the eye through the dense crop. The effect is tense, dramatic, and tactile, with modern graphic design fused to visibly worked paint.
style_prompt_zh: 动画风绘画把锐利切分的焦点平面与机械曲线压进紧密裁切、高对比构图。午夜蓝、紫罗兰、炭黑和电光绿对抗集中的橙红光。大胆棱角轮廓确立中央形体，粗刷痕、小刮痕和印刷般颗粒打断干净赛璐璐阴影区域。一道狭窄明亮焦点平面接住硬暖光，相邻表面迅速退入冷紫阴影。大弯板状形体与斜向丝状笔痕在压缩空间里咬合，却不丢失剪影清晰度。少数精准亮边和饱和重音引导视线穿过密集裁切。效果紧张、戏剧性而可触，把现代图形设计与明显加工过的颜料融为一体。
theme_en: Intense young pilot in close view with a violet armored shoulder
theme_zh: 紫色装甲肩部旁的近景少年驾驶员
name: Evangelion
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
